summary: IHateMoney is a web application designed to help groups track and settle shared expenses. It provides a centralised ledger so you can record who paid for what and calculate who owes money to whom.
goodFor: It suits flatmates, small travel groups, or social circles needing a straightforward tool to split bills without relying on commercial third-party platforms.
watchOut: The project sees moderate maintenance activity, so you should expect slower responses to bug fixes and feature requests.
deployNotes: Because it runs as a Python and Docker container, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your ledger data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
